parameters.jsCode: const body=$input.first().json.body;const required=['feedback_items'];const missing=required.filter(f=>!body[f]);if(missing.length)return[{json:{valid:false,error:'Missing: '+missing.join(', ')}}];const items=Array.isArray(body.feedback_items)?body.feedback_items:[];if(items.length===0)return[{json:{valid:false,error:'feedback_items must be non-empty'}}];const formattedItems=items.slice(0,60).map((item,i)=>({id:item.id||('FB-'+String(i+1).padStart(3,'0')),source:item.source||'unknown',customerSegment:item.customer_segment||'',planTier:item.plan_tier||'',revenue:parseFloat(item.revenue)||null,text:(item.text||item.feedback||'').trim().slice(0,400),votes:parseInt(item.votes)||1,type:item.type||'feature_request',status:item.status||'open',submittedAt:item.submitted_at||''}));const totalItems=formattedItems.length;const totalVotes=formattedItems.reduce((s,i)=>s+i.votes,0);const byType={};formattedItems.forEach(item=>{byType[item.type]=(byType[item.type]||0)+1;});return[{json:{valid:true,productName:(body.product_name||'').trim(),productStrategy:(body.product_strategy||'').slice(0,400),currentRoadmap:(body.current_roadmap||'').slice(0,500),icpDescription:(body.icp_description||'').slice(0,300),feedbackItems:formattedItems,totalItems,totalVotes,byType,replyEmail:body.reply_email||null}}];

values.content: You prioritize product feedback for product managers. Good prioritization: surfaces the underlying need behind feature requests (not just the surface ask), groups similar feedback into themes, weights by customer revenue and segment fit (not just vote count), identifies what the feedback reveals about product gaps, and gives honest assessments of what to build vs what not to build. Always respond in valid JSON only.
